Treatment summary
Patient presented after a side-impact collision at an intersection with complaints of right shoulder pain. The mechanism of injury
described is consistent with the reported shoulder complaint. Over four visits, care consisted of conservative management
including rest, activity modification, and a short course of anti-inflammatory medication with gentle range-of-motion exercises.
Symptoms improved steadily, and visit frequency was reduced accordingly as the patient progressed. The patient reports ongoing
pain, and nearly all of the documented symptoms rest on the patient's own description of discomfort. Shoulder imaging and the
orthopedic provocative tests performed were witihn normal limits. No prior injury or treatment involving this shoulder is known.
Billing reocrds reflect one charge per visit with no duplicated or repeated services. Plan going forward is home exercise and
follow-up as needed.
